subject: biology
qualificationNote: OCR A Level Biology A (H420)|Four components: 01 Biological processes (100 marks, 2h15, 37%, modules 1/2/3/5), 02 Biological diversity (100 marks, 2h15, 37%, modules 1/2/4/6), 03 Unified biology (70 marks, 1h30, 26%, all modules 1-6), 04 Practical Endorsement (non-exam assessment, reported separately); co-teachable with the standalone AS Level in Biology A (H020) whose course is modules 1-4, with modules 5 and 6 additional at full A level.
